import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for event details. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def prepare_event_details(headline: str, summary: str, scheduled_date: str, additional_info: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- headline : str Title or name of the event. summary : str Comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple paragraphs). scheduled_date : str Scheduled date of the event. additional_info : str Supplementary information or instructions. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML suitable for secure display. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to neutralize potential XSS payloads. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_summary = html.escape(summary, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_info = html.escape(additional_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Render the invitation using the safe values. html_output = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_headline, event_description=safe_summary, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_info ) return html_output
